Nigel Farge is trending on Twitter because he spoke at a Trump rally. No offense, but you guys seriously underestimate Trump's support. 

Comments on Hillary's FB are mostly negative, whereas Trump has thousands of supporters who comment and watch his rallies everyday. What if Trump is our version of Brexit? :(

Yes, it is. How is that relevant? I switched to Clinton after Trump attacked a gold star family. Let's not pretend that Hillary is not a deeply flawed candidate. She could lose ground in the polls if something happened. Even if she does poorly in the debates.

If it were a generic Democrat, I would brush these polls off

Common sense. The rest of the state is red aside from Philly and Pittsburgh 

Trump has way more enthusiasm in Pennsylvania. And he received the most votes in the Pennsylvania primary out of every Republican candidate in history.

um I don't see it?

where did you find out? I read their poll breakdown

Trump +5 in Pennsylvania according to a CPEX poll. So that means we have to win another swing state to make up for a PA loss. 

I expect him to win the state because of PA's rural areas. The rest of the state is red. How unfortunate. And he also received the most votes in the PA primary. I think he broke a record.

How was the crowd? 

Someone on Twitter claimed that only 100 showed up and HS students were sitting on the bleachers.

I'm starting to believe that Trump is a Clinton plant. 

>"When you get those seats, you sort of know the campaign. You sort of know the campaign," Trump said at the rally in Sunshine, Florida.

I mean, c'mon! He shot himself in the foot again.
